svg.title: solo-lab architecture
svg.desc: People, AI clients and agents call through Solo gateways: kgateway at the edge and agentgateway for every agent, tool and model call. agentgateway routes each sign-in to an IdP, checks who and which workload is calling and what their sign-in proves, and mints each tool or SaaS a token for that one call. Behind it, the identity fabric: S&V's broker and its IdPs in failover order. Istio ambient gives every workload mTLS and a SPIFFE identity.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: An identity fabric built with Solo

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: Every IdP a firm owns, through one gateway, to every agent, tool, SaaS and model it uses. People and agents sign in once; every call is checked and gets a token for that call alone.
